pins.name: BROWN
pins.notes: Supply + from an external 6 to 36 V supply (e.g. 12 V). Never to the ESP32

pins.name: BLUE
pins.notes: Supply 0 V. Connect to ESP32 GND too (common ground)

pins.name: BLACK
pins.notes: NPN output, LOW when an object is near. Some units pull it up to the supply: measure first, use an optocoupler or divider

sources.title: LJC18A3-H-Z/BX seller datasheet
sources.section: Supply 6 to 36 V DC; NPN NO output; range 1 to 10 mm (adjustable); brown +, blue 0 V, black signal
